metadata.title: Will AI Replace My Test Scripts?
metadata.narration_policy: Narration is SCRIPT.md verbatim, one script section per beat. Beat IDs B01-B11 match script sections 1-11; BVDT, BHTF and BOUT are sections 12, 13 and 14. Source tags, stage directions and the 'Prompt shown on screen' line are not narrated.
metadata.visual_policy: Simple illustrative graphics only: a mock web page, a popup with an ×, locators, a test's find, act, check steps, a look, decide, act, check loop. No real product logos, no screenshots of commercial tools, and no employer details. Code on screen is real, readable Selenium/JUnit API, labelled as illustrative and not run. The Claude composer, verdict page and the channel mark are redrawn bookends, not screenshots.

fill_policy.gate: Gate V (final_frame_check.py): content bounding box must cover at least 55% of the safe area at 50% and at 85% of every beat.
fill_policy.rule: Every Manim scene is built to fill the safe area at both sample points: large type, large objects, no top-clustered layouts. No beat is declared sparse_by_design unless a render proves it cannot pass, and then only with a written reason.

portrait_layout.min_type: Readable portrait type: nothing below the portrait type floor enforced by Gate T; code and labels are enlarged and re-broken for 9:16, not scaled down from 16:9.
portrait_layout.rule: In 9:16, all text and labels sit above 86% of the frame height (y < 0.86 * H), leaving the bottom 14% empty. Each portrait scene has its own native layout.

metadata.library_check: Searched with ./art scenes first (see SHOTLIST.md). Reused: ClaudeComposerAsk, BrutalistHesitantWriter, ClaudeVerdictArtifact, LogoOutro (and their 916 variants). No library match for a mock page with a popup, locator tags, find-act-check test steps, a page object, a self-healing candidate scorer, a look-decide-act-check ring, or a cost/limits panel, so those beats are custom Manim scenes in scenes.py.
metadata.reformat: full-length; native portrait graphics; preserve source framing
